data.name: Hamza
data.gender_notes: Hamza is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ح-م-ز (ḥ-m-z); Ḥamza denotes a lion or a strong, sharp person. Its root is ح-م-ز (ḥ-m-z). Borne by Ḥamza ibn ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib, uncle of the Prophet ﷺ. Hamza is a Arabic name meaning “Lion; strong; steadfast”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hamza expresses “Lion; strong; steadfast”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ح-م-ز (ḥ-m-z); Ḥamza denotes a lion or a strong, sharp person.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hamza total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
